title: Aiming to Catch Them in the Crossfire
text: “Grr… I get what you’re trying to say, but that doesn’t make it any less infuriating!”
“The reason I decided to turn you into a riska was your attitude toward me the day after Father’s duel, when you went and demanded a reward from Trash, I say!”

“It’s true Itsuki was riding way too high on himself back then… I get that getting thrashed that badly by Naofumi put him in a foul mood, but did something else happen? I left that whole business to you two, so I wouldn’t know.”
“He still believed that nonsense about Father attacking the Crimson Swine, indeed.”
“And after that, didn’t you get him to tear up the invoice he tried to charge Naofumi-san, calling it unjust!?”
“Never heard of such a thing! That was a full house I was trying to show him, so he’d stop looking away from the truth about Melromarc, I say.”
Knowing how things went, Itsuki would have kept right on believing Father was the villain, no doubt about it.
“I had my doubts too, you know!”
“That’s the kind of thing you forget the moment it’s out of sight, pyon! I know because I’ve looped through it, pyon!”
Since I was planning to raise Fleon-chan after this anyway, Itsuki waking up to true justice was already on the schedule — I’d simply helped speed things along a little, indeed.
“Ahh… so you’re saying there’s a loop where Itsuki doesn’t change even after getting beaten senseless. Didn’t you say something about him being unusually thickheaded?”
“Are you trying to say my eyes are that full of holes!?”
“If anything, given the state of things, the fact that Itsuki could still call Naofumi the villain probably means this was necessary to straighten you out.”
Ka-ka-ka! Itsuki loosed three arrows straight at me, pinning me down, but I skillfully shifted my stance and caught them all, I say.
“Even so, that doesn’t erase the pain and humiliation I’ve just suffered!”
“Now, now, Itsuki, calm down. It’s not like Motoyasu-kun did this for no reason at all…”
Father tried to soothe Itsuki, indeed.
Wolf! Don’t think I didn’t notice you sneaking a ride on Father’s shoulders in all this chaos! And Itsuki, don’t you go climbing on so easily either, pyon!
“I understand why Itsuki got put through the wringer. But I never had that kind of hostility toward you!”
“Well, you did have Kuro-chan pestering you, and you were so drunk you could barely stand… and on top of that, you’d figured out the whole farce the kingdom was pulling.”
Come to think of it, Ren had been fine even left alone for a while after that, hadn’t he.
“I figured he’d eventually awaken as the Shadow Saint through his bond with Kuro-chan, but…”
“Cut the crap! So why the hell did you do this to me!? What were you even thinking, dropping me while I was walking a tightrope!?”
“Well, obviously…”
I let the silence hang, mimicking the way Rafumi does it, indeed.
“You were just caught up with Itsuki, pyon. No deep meaning behind it, pyon! As for the tightrope thing, that was just routine work, I felt nothing about it, pyon!”
I declared it with a beaming smile, pyon!
“Gah! Anyone can see that’s a smile straight from the bottom of your heart!”
“I left a knife infused with terrifying power near you back in Zeltoble so you could go be some dark cuisine chef named Kelsus or whatever — why didn’t you take up cooking, hm?”
“Ahh… so there really was intent behind that.”
“Cut the craaaaaap!”
Ren’s furious roar echoed through the air.
“Do you have any idea how miserable you made me!? And you call it ‘caught up in it’!? Enough already!”
“Ho!”
Using the force of Ren’s attack, I cut the ropes binding me and made my escape, indeed.
“Fu ha ha ha! If you think something this pathetic can hold me, you’re sorely mistaken, pyon! Now then, let’s play, pyon!”
“Damn! I figured he was aiming at the ropes on purpose, and he still got free!”
“I won’t let you get away! Do you know how long I’ve waited for this moment!? I will absolutely kill you!”
Ren and Itsuki both turned their attacks on me as I tried to make my escape.
“Damn! That Motoyasu bastard is crafty! He’s positioning himself between me and Itsuki on purpose to drag us both down together!”
“Scurrying around like that! Don’t you dare underestimate me! I happen to be quite good at quick-draw shooting, you know!”
“Ah, the Skill of Certain Hit, is it! But if I just dodge from the spot right after you fire, it won’t land, pyon!”
And while I’m at it, why not just grab Ren and use him as a shield, pyon!
“Ren-san! It can’t be helped if a fool gets hit by accident, right? Minimal collateral, that’s all.”
I maneuvered so that Ren stood right in Itsuki’s line of fire to disrupt his attack, but it seemed Itsuki was fully prepared to take Ren down along with me, indeed.
“Are you calling this ‘collateral damage,’ Itsuki!? You’re playing right into Motoyasu’s scheme to turn us against each other!”
“Like I care! There’s no way to take down an usaunny without some sacrifices! If you don’t want to die, Ren-san, you’d better fight like your life depends on it too!”
“Itsuki! You bastaaaard! Guh!”
A life-or-death coordinated assault from Ren and Itsuki, indeed. But if I put my mind to it, dealing with a pair as unpolished as you two is child’s play, pyon!
“Damn it! My enhancements should be more than enough, but my technique can’t keep up! Waaaaaaargh! Itsuki, don’t get in my way!”

Ren went into some kind of focus mode and lunged at me, but he still had a long way to go, indeed. Meanwhile Itsuki kept loosing arrows in the gaps, but they only ended up getting in Ren’s way whenever he attacked. Their teamwork still needed a lot of work, pyon.
“Wolf-san! At this rate you’ll stay some creature called a peckul forever, you know! Catch Motoyasu-san like your life depends on it. I’ll deliver the finishing blow!”
“W-Woof. Even staying like this is fine, so long as Naofumi-sama keeps doting on me.”
It seemed Itsuki’s words had lured Wolf into joining the fray too, indeed. I swung my spear in a wide arc, sweeping it around while keeping my distance, I say.

“Hmm… what is this, exactly. Ren, Itsuki, and Wolf all look like they’re fighting some kind of life-or-death final battle, but somehow, with the way they’re moving, it just looks like some kind of party animal act.”
Father seemed to be watching our battle unfold with a distant, glassy look in his eyes, indeed.
“What is it, what’s going on!? What… what are the Heroes even fighting against?”
Starting with Crocodile Guy, the people around us began gathering, drawn in by the commotion, indeed.
“Hmph… so you’ve finally shown your true colors, have you.”
Rafumi crossed her arms and looked on like some outside spectator, but I decided to drag her into it too, indeed. I fled toward Rafumi, dragging Ren, Itsuki, and Wolf right along with me, indeed.
“You’re approaching rather blatantly, aren’t you.”
“Fu ha ha ha! I’m dragging you into this too, indeed!”
“It’s starting to look like an all-out brawl now…”
“It’s trying to kick up a big fuss just because it doesn’t want its secret exposed, nano.”
Before I knew it, Rival was… tch, standing right beside Father, so I couldn’t drag it in.
“What’s with that rabbit!?”
Rabbit Guy was also safely tucked away near Father, indeed. Damn it! Once I win this, I’ll drive him off later, I say!
“If you think I’m going to keep playing defense forever, you’re sorely mistaken, pyon! Take this, pyon!”
I unleashed a Skill with a wide, sweeping strike from my stun-effect spear, and it slammed straight into Ren’s head, indeed.
“Guwaaah—!? …”
Thwack! The Skill struck Ren’s head, and he crumpled to the ground, indeed.
“R-Ren!? Are you okay!?”
Ren twitched, spasming faintly, but then, in the middle of trading blows with Wolf, he suddenly sprang back up.
“Ha! Still not done yeeeeeet!”
Oh, his recovery was faster than expected, indeed. Guess I’d better hit him with a bit more enhancement and go all out.
“Itsuki, take this too, pyon! Paralyze Lance X!”
“I’ve learned from experience — status ailments, I’ve got countermeasures ready — ugh—”
“Fu ha ha! I’ve got penetration against resistance fully mastered too, thanks to years of accumulated enhancement, indeed!”
Did you really think the paltry resistance you picked up could nullify me!? Not a chaaaance!
“Next up, Rafumi and Wolf, pyoooon!”
“Hmph! If you think I’m getting mixed up in this, you’re sorely mistaken.”
With a poof, Rafumi vanished on the spot. Damn it, pyon!
